title: Clear Numbers
notes: Much less number spam: hits from the same source on the same enemy merge into one growing number (e.g. 565 x2).
You can see where damage comes from: white = sword strikes, ✦ in your element colour = skills, ⟲ gold = parries, ❖ = spirits, gold with ! = critical hit.
After every fight a damage bar shows your split (e.g. Skills 68%, Parries 21%, Strikes 10%) with a tip on what to invest in.
Talent points now shine as a gold badge. On phones the battle buttons have short labels so everything fits.
